purpose: Catalog of ORPHE CORE / ORPHE INSOLE examples built on ORPHE-CORE-INSOLE.js (orphe-core-insole.js). All examples use the shared OrpheCoreInsole API (v0.2.0+). Paths are relative to the repository root.

status_definitions.public: Worth keeping in public navigation. Device verification can still be tracked separately.
status_definitions.public-candidate: Valuable, but needs copy, thumbnail, validation, or small cleanup before promotion.
status_definitions.needs-fix: Known broken path, stale dependency, or behavior issue.
status_definitions.needs-review: Likely valuable, but purpose, audience, or device behavior needs review.
status_definitions.internal: QA or maintenance tool. Not counted as a public example.
status_definitions.overlap: Useful as part of a family, but confusing if presented as a separate top-level example.

entries.title: Terminal

display_schema.thumbnail: Path to an existing preview image, or null when one still needs to be prepared.
display_schema.sort_order: Integer used for stable public navigation ordering. Required when public_navigation is featured.
display_schema.links: Entry points for demos, source directories, docs, or API pages.
display_schema.requires_device: True when the example is only meaningful with ORPHE CORE hardware or a compatible BLE device.
display_schema.device_count: Expected number of ORPHE CORE modules. Mirrors devices while making display code explicit.
display_schema.needs_real_device_validation: True when the catalog entry still needs physical ORPHE CORE verification.
display_schema.device: core | insole | both — which device the example targets
